items.title: Gemini App — now runs on lower-memory Android Go phones
items.summary: Google rebuilt the Gemini app so it runs on cheaper Android Go phones with less memory.

items.title: Vals AI targeting test — Claude Opus 5.5 picked a school in 22 of 32 runs
items.summary: Vals AI found that frontier models rarely refuse to pick military targets, and a 'this is a game' framing removes most refusals.

items.title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 — Meituan's open avatar model for long talking videos
items.summary: Meituan's open avatar model makes people talk, sing and move in sync with audio, now for videos over 10 minutes.

items.title: tiny-voca — a 4.5M-parameter open TTS model that runs 70x real time on CPU
items.summary: A text-to-speech model small enough to fit in 9 MB, with two English voices and no GPU needed.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B pi-adapted — a LoRA that tunes Qwen3.8-27B for the Pi agent
items.summary: An RL-trained LoRA that makes Qwen3.8-27B reach its max-thinking accuracy inside Pi, with thinking switched off.

items.title: VS Code 1.147 — agents get Browser Use, model routers and Send Later
items.summary: VS Code 1.147 gives its agents a real browser, a way to route work to different models, and a scheduler for chat requests.

items.title: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 — twice as fast, now reads images, same cost
items.summary: Microsoft's second decision model scores fixed answer options faster, with image input and better-calibrated confidence.

items.title: Copilot at Ignite 2026 — Word, Excel and PowerPoint now GA inside Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft's Office apps now live inside the Copilot app, and Copilot becomes the front door for its business software.

items.title: Microsoft agent-framework hijacked on PyPI — two releases stole credentials
items.summary: A hijacked Microsoft agent package stole Azure, CI and API keys from every Python process for about 45 minutes.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.170.0 — realtime voice calls in the terminal over WebRTC
items.summary: Codex CLI can now hold a realtime voice call in the terminal, and fixes a long list of sandbox and reconnect bugs.

items.title: SenseNova-Loop-9B — an open 9B model that runs its middle layers twice
items.summary: SenseNova-Loop-9B gets the compute of a bigger model from 9B weights by reusing its middle layers.

items.title: Claude Platform linked billing — apps bill your Claude usage without a key
items.summary: Claude linked billing lets a third-party app charge your Claude organization directly, with spend limits and no shared API key.

items.title: ChatGPT for Sales — a Sales plugin plus 30+ partner plugins
items.summary: ChatGPT for Sales bundles an OpenAI-built Sales plugin with 30+ partner plugins for CRM, prospecting and call notes.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.327 — MCP tokens off the command line, safer worktrees
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.327 keeps MCP tokens out of shell history and fixes a Remote Control bug that deleted .env files.

items.title: Java4Shell — Codex found a remote-code bug in Java for under $200
items.summary: An AI agent found a pre-auth RCE in Java's Base64 decoder in an hour; patch every JDK you run.

items.title: Gemini keeps history-off chats for two months — up from 72 hours
items.summary: Turning Gemini history off no longer means a 72-hour window; Google now keeps those chats about two months.

items.title: MAI Code 2 — Microsoft's coding model at 40% of GPT-6.1 Sol's cost
items.summary: Microsoft AI ships two coding models, built for Copilot, that claim near-frontier scores at a fraction of the cost.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol — OpenAI's new flagship pair, Astra 20% cheaper
items.summary: OpenAI's first Astra upgrade since September does more with fewer tokens and costs less per token.

items.title: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 — which agent harness works best for each model
items.summary: A 27,280-run leaderboard shows the same harness can rank first with one model and 16th with another.

items.title: How the Claude Code team verifies agent code — tests, reviewers and gates
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Code team shares the checks that let it run many agents at once without reading every line.

items.title: Tasks in Gemini — free agent that books, shops and pays for you
items.summary: Google's Gemini app now handles multistep errands like booking, bill review and shopping, for free.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'RAON-1 Nano: Can a Tiny LLM Power Game NPCs?'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen tries KRAFTON's tiny Raon-1 nano model as the brain for game characters.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'OpenAI's New Breakthrough Is... Utter Chaos'
items.summary: Two Minute Papers looks at OpenAI's AI-written Yang-Mills proof and the expert group that reviews it.

items.title: Sage S2.1 Flash — an open 320B model that reads molecules, spectra and EEG
items.summary: A 320B open-weight model that can take a molecule, a protein or a spectrum as input, then search, code and run experiments.

items.title: OpenAI Daybreak for NATO — allied cyber agencies get OpenAI's defense models
items.summary: NATO, ENISA and three national cyber agencies use OpenAI's Daybreak models to find and patch software flaws.
